newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Dbn Dp details results of West Wits offer.
newsitem.headline: Dbn Dp details results of West Wits offer.

text.p: Durban Roodepoort Deep Ltd (DRD) said on Tuesday the three offers made in August to shareholders in a bid to buy West Witwatersrand Gold Holdings Ltd had been accepted by not less than 90 percent of shareholders.
DRD said in a statement it desired to acquire the remainder of the offer instruments from holders who did not accept the offers.
It said a notice would be posted on October 11 to those who did not accept the share offer.

Thereafter, West Wits would be suspended from the Johannesburg Stock Exchange from close of business on Friday and would be delisted on November 15, provided no application is made to the Supreme Court by the remaining West Wits shareholders.
